title: Concept: Module declares no licence metadata
description: pom.xml declares a pom.xml with no `<licenses>` block, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a pom.xml with no `<licenses>` block.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a pom.xml with no `<licenses>` block.
